messages:
anya: heads-up — noticed an auth failure pattern after yesterday's key rotation. embeddings routes (/v1/embeddings/*) returning 403 for tokens that should still be valid. not a mass outage but a steady stream from a few internal services.

josh: which key? rotated customer key or internal service key?

anya: internal service key: svc-embed-ingest. rotation finished ~1990012000 according to deploy-bot. requests show scope mismatch: token has scopes [embeddings:generate] but enforcer says missing per-route scope 'model:gpt-embed-v1'.

kevin: that sounds like the new per-model scope enforcement we rolled out last week. are we sure rotated key preserved key-metadata in KMS? if metadata lost, auth path might fallback to route-level checks and fail.

anya: log snippet: `authz: token=svc-embed-ingest id=uuid-1234 scopes=[embeddings:generate] route=/v1/embeddings/create model=gpt-embed-v1 result=DENY reason="missing_scope: model:gpt-embed-v1"`

karen: hmm. if token only has generic embeddings scope we intended model-level enforcement to accept embeddings:generate for all models unless per-model restriction present. looks like the enforcement is treating unspecified model->strict per-model require. could be default policy change.

josh: can you grep for policy version used by enforcer at the time? maybe a rollout toggled the stricter policy.

deploy-bot: rollout svc-authz v2.3.0 completed at 1990011950 on cluster-prod-3.

kevin: v2.3.0 introduced 'require_model_scope_if_model_specified' flag to authz config (opt-in). somebody flipped it on during a canary — we thought only internal services had tokens with explicit model scopes.

anya: that matches. rotated keys issued by key-rotation job call KMS to wrap new key but we never re-attached 'allowed_model' metadata to the new wrapper entry. so the authz decision can't find model allowance metadata and falls back to strict check.

karen: so two things: (1) key-rotation should preserve/restore KMS metadata tags that map tokens->allowed_models, (2) authz should treat missing metadata as permissive for backward compatibility for a bit.

josh: agree. short-term mitigation: flip the flag off on prod authz config or patch enforcer to treat empty metadata as permissive for tokens issued before rotation cutoff.

kevin: easy patch: if token.scopes contains embeddings:generate and route is embeddings, allow unless explicit deny present. I can cut a hotfix to v2.3.1.

anya: for immediate mitigation I disabled require_model_scope_if_model_specified on prod at 1990012400. traffic returned to normal for svc-embed-ingest. monitoring green.

karen: please create an incident doc and postmortem. we need a checklist change: rotation job must copy KMS key labels/tags and the key-issue flow must verify authz metadata mapping.

josh: opened ticket SEC-4492 with remediation steps and timeline. tagging @kevin for the hotfix and @anya for rotation job fix.

kevin: prepping v2.3.1 branch now. will run unit test for metadata-preservation case.

deploy-bot: audit-bot recorded event: policy-flag-change by karen at 1990012405.

audit-bot: appended audit entry: key-rotation svc-embed-ingest preserved_labels=false at 1990011988.

anya: one extra note — observed few API clients that embed model name in the route (deprecated) — make sure authz fallback covers both per-route and per-model legacy patterns.

karen: good catch. include legacy-route patterns in the fix. also add a regression test in CI that simulates KMS metadata loss during rotation.

josh: timeline estimate: hotfix <2h, rotation-job patch next-day, CI tests + rollout 2 days.

kevin: pushing hotfix now. will ping when v2.3.1 deployed to canary.

anya: thanks all. leaving this thread pinned to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
